text:
Maya: ok team — we need to lock scope for the Q3 perf hypersprint. customers are pushing for both lower p99 for chat and cheaper embeddings. I want a decision by EOD on: kernels vs quantization order, KV cache prefetching, and canary rollout plan. high level goals: p99 -30% for chat workloads, embed cost -20%, no >3% memory regressions.

Samir: I vote kernel-first for tail improvements. quant gives cost wins but can make tail worse on long sequences. proposal: ship kernel micro-optimizations + better thread pinning in sprint 1, follow with quantization profiling sprint 2. canary at 10-20% traffic.

Liam: agree on kernel-first. also we need to tighten KV cache invalidation rules — prefetch helps throughput but can increase mem pressure. rough config I want to test:
```
kv.prefetch.enabled = true
kv.prefetch.max_items = 64
kv.prefetch.ttl_ms = 100
kv.cache.eviction_policy = lru
```
we should add per-route prefetch toggles.

Rachel: launch criteria suggestion: p50/p95/p99 vs baseline, throughput at 95th percentile load, regressions (mem/cpu) <3%, end-to-end user-facing latency on representative prompt suites, and a validated rollback path. add synthetic workloads + a sampled production replay.

perf-bot: nightly-run: kernel-opt branch -> avg latency -9%, p99 -18% on chat-128; int8-quant branch -> avg -12% but p99 +6% on seq>2048. failing tests: memory-leak-smoketest on r5.

Samir: that matches my concerns. decision: prioritize kernel work that reduces tail, run quant experiments in parallel but don't promote quant to canary until tail is addressed. owners: Samir (kernels), Liam (kv prefetch & infra), Rachel (criteria & test harness). timeline: 3-week kernel sprint, 2-week quant profiling, then combined canary.

Maya: assigning owners confirmed. Samir — please open a short spec PR with micro-ops list + measurement plan. Liam — add per-route prefetch feature flag + mem guard rails. Rachel — draft launch checklist and rollback playbook. link your PRs here when ready (e.g. https://internal.redwood/repo/PR).

Rachel: will include customer comms template and a checklist: smoke, perf, stability, metrics dashboard, alert thresholds, fallback policy. Also request to include a short blurb for support playbook.

Maya: cool. meeting to reconvene next Tue 11am to triage perf numbers and lock canary percentage. if anyone wants to reprioritize, flag today. :thumbsup:
